name: getting-started
description: A comprehensive getting started guide for AI Hub. Learn how to discover resources, check compatibility, and integrate AI components into your projects. This tutorial covers the basics of semantic search, metadata validation, and autonomous resource discovery.

installation.command: pip install ai-hub && git clone https://github.com/welshDog/AI.git

usage.quickstart:
from ai_hub import SemanticSearch
search = SemanticSearch()
results = search.find('transformer model')
usage.example_code:
# Complete getting started example
from ai_hub import SemanticSearch, AIAutonomyClient

# Initialize search
search = SemanticSearch()

# Find resources
models = search.find(
    query='sentiment analysis model',
    resource_type='model',
    tags=['nlp'],
    limit=5
)

# Check compatibility
from ai_hub import CompatibilityChecker
checker = CompatibilityChecker()
report = checker.check_resource(
    'models/nlp/bert-base',
    environment={'python': '3.9.0', 'platform': 'linux'}
)

print(f'Compatible: {report.is_compatible}')
